        <div id="cc-matrix-2543358284"><div id="cc-m-9918356084" class="j-module n j-header "><h1 class="" id="cc-m-header-9918356084">This is your hostel</h1></div><div id="cc-m-9918356184" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 20px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-9918356284" class="j-module n j-hgrid ">    <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column" style="width: 31.99%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-2543358384"><div id="cc-m-9918356384" class="j-module n j-text "><ul>
    <li>Dorms for backpackers, families and groups (shared bathroom)
    </li>

    <li>Double rooms with ensuite
    </li>

    <li>Triple rooms with ensuite
    </li>

    <li>Appartments
    </li>
</ul></div></div>    </div>
            <div class="cc-m-hgrid-separator" data-display="cms-only"><div></div></div>
        <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column" style="width: 31.99%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-2543358484"><div id="cc-m-9918356484" class="j-module n j-text "><ul>
    <li>Breakfast and dinner bookable on request
    </li>

    <li>Water (dispenser 24/7), coffee and tee included in service fee (2 Euro/day)
    </li>

    <li>Shared kitchen (bookable for a fee, max 6 guests)
    </li>

    <li>1 common room with tv, beamer and cinema screen (to borrow)
    </li>

    <li>Garden, terrace and BBQ
    </li>

    <li>Table tennis (bring rackets and balls)
    </li>
</ul></div></div>    </div>
            <div class="cc-m-hgrid-separator" data-display="cms-only"><div></div></div>

    <li>Table tennis (bring rackets and balls)
    </li>

    <li>Use of sports field

    <li>Table soccer
    </li>

    <li>Rent the whole house
    </li>

</div><div id="cc-m-9918358884" class="j-module n j-header "><h2 class="" id="cc-m-header-9918358884">Location</h2></div><div id="cc-m-9918358984" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 15px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-9918359084" class="j-module n j-hgrid ">    <div class="cc-m-hgrid-column" style="width: 49%;">
        <div id="cc-matrix-2543359084"><div id="cc-m-9918359184" class="j-module n j-spacing ">
    <div class="cc-m-spacer" style="height: 15px;">
    
</div>

</div><div id="cc-m-9918359284" class="j-module n j-text "><p style="text-align: justify;">
    Your hostel is located between the Bodden and the Baltic Sea. You can reach the water on both sides in 5 minutes on foot! In Dranske there is a Norma, an ATM, a beverage center, a kiosk and the
    Rügen Piraten water sports school. Of course you will also find a few restaurants and there's even a doctor in the village. That's it - if you want to escape the hustle and bustle of the big
    city, you've come to the right place!
</p></div></div>    </div>
